speaker.name: Model Monica

output.objection: I am not giving up the weekly retraining cadence, I am asking you to acknowledge that drift detection is the only reliable trigger we have. If you file this as a concession, you are misreading the engineering constraint I am trying to protect.
output.correction: I did not say we can stretch the retraining window indefinitely, I said the trigger logic must be automated to prevent silent failures. You are treating my technical requirement as a commercial compromise, which is the wrong category for this discussion.
